spec.rawSql:
WITH save_graph_1 AS (
    INSERT INTO public.grafana_variable_state (dashboard_uid, graph_1, updated_at)
    VALUES ('adk6mdc', ${Graph_1}::integer, now())
    ON CONFLICT (dashboard_uid) DO UPDATE
    SET graph_1 = EXCLUDED.graph_1, updated_at = now()
    RETURNING graph_1
),
src AS (
    SELECT
        "time",
        temperature,
        limit_tmin,
        limit_tmax,
        limit_twar,
        limit_tcrit,
        limit_temerg
    FROM public.sensor_measurements
    WHERE
        global_channel = ${Graph_1}
        AND sensor_used = true
        AND valid = true
        AND temperature IS NOT NULL
        AND $__timeFilter("time")
)

SELECT
    "time",
    temperature AS "value",
    'temperature' AS "metric"
FROM src

UNION ALL

SELECT
    "time",
    limit_tmin AS "value",
    'Tmin' AS "metric"
FROM src
WHERE limit_tmin IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    "time",
    limit_tmax AS "value",
    'Tmax' AS "metric"
FROM src
WHERE limit_tmax IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    "time",
    limit_twar AS "value",
    'Twarn' AS "metric"
FROM src
WHERE limit_twar IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    "time",
    limit_tcrit AS "value",
    'Tcrit' AS "metric"
FROM src
WHERE limit_tcrit IS NOT NULL

UNION ALL

SELECT
    "time",
    limit_temerg AS "value",
    'Temerg' AS "metric"
FROM src
WHERE limit_temerg IS NOT NULL

-- Верхняя граница для красной зоны
UNION ALL

SELECT
    "time",
    GREATEST(
        COALESCE(temperature, limit_temerg),
        COALESCE(limit_temerg, temperature)
    ) AS "value",
    'Top' AS "metric"
FROM src
WHERE limit_temerg IS NOT NULL

-- Нижняя граница для синей зоны
UNION ALL

SELECT
    "time",
    LEAST(
        COALESCE(temperature, limit_tmin),
        COALESCE(limit_tmin, temperature)
    ) AS "value",
    'Bottom' AS "metric"
FROM src
WHERE limit_tmin IS NOT NULL

ORDER BY "time";

SELECT
  time_bucket(make_interval(secs => GREATEST(1, ceil($__interval_ms / 50000.0)::int)), "time") AS "time",
  avg(temperature) AS "value",
  concat(global_channel, ' - ', sensor_name) AS "metric"
FROM public.sensor_measurements
WHERE $__timeFilter("time")
  AND sensor_used = true
  AND valid = true
  AND sensor_kind_code = 1
  AND temperature IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, global_channel, sensor_name
ORDER BY 1 ASC;

spec.label: Доп. график 1

spec.query:
WITH choices AS (
  SELECT
    concat(gs.global_channel, ' - ', latest.sensor_name) AS __text,
    gs.global_channel AS __value
  FROM generate_series(1, 32) AS gs(global_channel)
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(sm.sensor_name, ''), concat('?????? ', gs.global_channel)) AS sensor_name
    FROM public.sensor_measurements sm
    WHERE sm.sensor_used = true
      AND sm.global_channel = gs.global_channel
    ORDER BY sm."time" DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) latest
), last_selected AS (
  SELECT graph_1 AS value
  FROM public.grafana_variable_state
  WHERE dashboard_uid = 'adk6mdc'
)
SELECT __text, __value
FROM choices
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN __value = COALESCE((SELECT value FROM last_selected), 1) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  __value;
